role: Git ignore rules for build output, Xcode user state, IDE files, OS junk, env files, archives, signing/secret material and internal working material.
toplevel: Ignores: build/, DerivedData/, *.pbxuser/mode*/perspectivev3 (except default.*), xcuserdata/, *.moved-aside, *.xccheckout, *.xcscmblueprint, *.hmap, *.ipa, *.dSYM(.zip), timeline.xctimeline, playground.xcworkspace, .swiftpm/xcode/ and .swiftpm/configuration/ (Package.resolved is NOT ignored, so the lockfile under Emuqu.xcodeproj is committed), Carthage/Build/, Dependencies/, .accio/, fastlane report/preview/screenshots/test_output, iOSInjectionProject/, macOS/Windows/Linux junk files, .claude/ (AI tooling state, line 111), .vscode/, .idea/, *.iml, vim swap files, .env/.env.local/.env.*.local (125-128), *.xcarchive, *.mobileprovision/*.provisionprofile, Crashlytics property files, *.pem/*.p12/*.p8/*.key/credentials.json/secrets.json (163-170; comment says testflight.yml writes an App Store Connect .p8 at build time), and do_not_ship/ (172-175: AI audit prompts, research prompts and hardware-gated plans kept out of public history). Also ignores .venv-codemap/ (the code-map tooling venv made by make codemap-setup) and __pycache__/ (Python bytecode, written when the code-map scripts import each other).

flags.text: Line 89 is the bare word 'Icon' followed by a plain LF (bytes 'I c o n \n'), although the comment on line 88 says it must end with two \r. The rule therefore ignores any file or directory literally named 'Icon' and does not ignore macOS custom-folder 'Icon\r' files it was meant for.
